sim.description: Reference to the sim record this constitution belongs to

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created

description.description: Full constitution text: beliefs, values, governance positions. Rich text annotations may be provided via descriptionFacets.

shortDescription.description: Short summary of this sim's constitution, suitable for previews and list views. Rich text annotations may be provided via shortDescriptionFacets.

descriptionFacets.description: Rich text annotations for description (mentions, URLs, hashtags, etc).

shortDescriptionFacets.description: Rich text annotations for shortDescription (mentions, URLs, hashtags, etc).

main.description: A sim's constitution and agent configuration. One document per sim.
